messages:
morgan: Noticed a bunch of onboarding issues where SDKs either swallow or misclassify 4xx responses. Sampleapp prints raw body which is ambiguous.

alex: Can you paste one of the ambiguous responses?

morgan: Sure. We currently emit this for validation errors and sometimes for malformed auth: 
```
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "invalid_input",
    "message": "prompt missing"
  }
}
```

morgan: Then another case is 422 with identical shape when payload passes schema but fails semantic checks.

tanvi: That's the problem. Status code + body both need to express intent. Otherwise SDKs have to guess.

jessica: Suggest we adopt a small error envelope with three canonical keys: `category`, `retryable`, `message`. e.g. `category: "auth" | "rate_limit" | "validation" | "internal"`.

sam: SDK parity note: Go maps on status codes, Python maps on `error.code`. Unless both read `category`, we'll keep diverging.

alex: Proposal: new schema for all error responses: 
```json
{
  "error": {"category": "rate_limit", "code": "too_many_requests", "retryable": true, "retry_after": 15, "message": "try again in 15s"}
}
```
This gives a machine-first signal plus human message.

morgan: I like `category` + `retryable`. `retry_after` optional. `code` can be a narrow string for logging/metrics.

jessica: For UX: keep `message` friendly and non-machine-parsable. SDKs should not parse it for logic. Document that.

tanvi: Can we add a simple compatibility layer in the sampleapp that maps old bodies -> new envelope? That will lessen immediate churn.

sam: I'll open a PR to update our Go error middleware and add the compatibility shim. Will include tests asserting `retryable` present for 429.

alex: SDK docs update needed: show how each language surfaces AuthError, RateLimitError (with `retry_after`), ValidationError. Also include recommended backoff (exp + jitter) when `retryable=true`.

morgan: QA: add a pytest in the sample repo that asserts 422 vs 400 differ in `category` values and that `retryable` is false for validation/auth.

jessica: One more thing: include a note for product teams to prefer `422 + category: validation` only when semantic validation failed. Keep `400` for syntactic bad requests. Helps clients who still rely on status codes.

deploy-bot: deploy-notice: sampleapp-canary rolling to v0.43.0 with error-envelope and compatibility shim. CI: tests/sampleapp/error-compat.test passed.

morgan: Great. I'll draft a short RFC with enum values and add a checklist for SDK parity and docs updates. Tagging Alex/Tanvi for review.

alex: Tag me please. I'll take the Go mapping section.

tanvi: I'll write the sampleapp QA test and a short blurb for onboarding saying "do not parse `message` for logic".

jessica: Thanks everyone. This will reduce confusion in support tickets.
